meta.name: ecommerce-full-pipeline
meta.description: 跨境电商全链路自动化工具。集成1688采集、智能清洗、多平台上架（微信小店/Shopify/TikTok）、推广方案（关键词/竞品分析/广告文案）、短视频创作（MoviePy竖屏视频）、一键代发、爆品挖掘（趋势聚合+6维评分）、闲鱼二手选品捡漏（品牌识别/虚标过滤/捡漏评分/价格监控）、全自动流水线（挖掘→采集→清洗→上架→推广→视频）。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动化处理跨境电商选品、上架到推广全流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你是跨境电商卖家，希望一键完成从选品到推广的全链路
copy.tagline_en: Automate the entire cross-border ecommerce pipeline from sourcing to promotion
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are a cross-border ecommerce seller wanting to automate the full workflow from sourcing to promotion

howto.what: 装上后，Claude能按指令执行跨境电商全流程：从1688采集商品、清洗数据，生成微信小店/Shopify/TikTok上架模板，制作推广方案和竖屏视频，也可代发下单、挖掘爆品或闲鱼捡漏。
howto.when: 当用户提出选品、上架、推广、视频制作等跨境电商需求，或要求闲鱼二手捡漏时触发。

say.text: 帮我采集1688上“蓝牙耳机”的商品，生成Shopify上架模板。
say.note: 会执行采集并输出上架模板。

say.text: 用闲鱼捡漏找预算1000以内的投影仪，要求4K和云台。
say.note: 会按参数筛选并给出捡漏评分。

say.text: 对已有商品数据生成推广文案和15秒竖屏视频。
say.note: 会生成推广方案和视频文件。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can execute cross-border e-commerce workflows: scrape products from 1688, clean data, generate listing templates for WeChat Shop/Shopify/TikTok, create marketing plans and vertical videos, place drop-shipping orders, discover trending products, or find Xianyu bargains.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks for cross-border e-commerce tasks like product selection, listing, promotion, video creation, or Xianyu second-hand bargain hunting.

say_en.text: Scrape products for 'wireless earphones' from 1688 and create a Shopify listing template.
say_en.note: It will scrape and output the template.

say_en.text: Use Xianyu bargain hunting to find a projector under 1000 yuan with 4K and gimbal.
say_en.note: It will filter by specs and give a bargain score.

say_en.text: Generate promotional copy and a 15-second vertical video for the existing product data.
say_en.note: It will produce marketing materials and a video.
